referenceSources.title: What could have been: The BTCC reunion that never happened
referenceSources.description:
A blue TWR Volvo S40, adorned with Hitachi, Ericsson, and Mobil1 logos, soars over a track curb in a high-speed corner. The rear view highlights the www.car.volvo.se decal on the roof spoiler and the S40 badge, while one wheel lifts off the asphalt, capturing the car’s aggressive suspension dynamics.

This image evokes the late 1990s British Touring Car Championship era, when Volvo’s TWR team campaigned the S40 with drivers like Rickard Rydell and Tim Harvey. The Mobil1 and Ericsson sponsorships reflect the commercial partnerships of the period, and the blurred crowd in the background underscores the excitement of live motorsport competition.
